forecastUnavailable.intro: The projected balance is not shown because at least one upcoming scheduled item cannot be priced yet. A projection runs one day into the next, so a single unknown amount would make every day after it wrong.
forecastUnavailable.requestFailed: The projected balance could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
forecastUnavailable.reasonUnavailable: The reason was not reported. Check the exchange rates for any scheduled item in a foreign currency.
forecastUnavailable.missingRatePair: {name}: no exchange rate is available for {from} to {to}, so the amount this occurrence will post is unknown.
forecastUnavailable.missingRate: {name}: the exchange rate this occurrence settles at is not available, so the amount it will post is unknown.
forecastUnavailable.crossCurrencyTransfer: {name}: a transfer arriving from an account in {from} while this account is in {to}. The amount that lands here is set when the transfer posts, so it cannot be projected in advance.
forecastUnavailable.unknownEstimate: {name}: the estimated amount cannot be worked out yet, because there are no payments to estimate it from. Enter this occurrence's amount, or record a payment.
forecastUnavailable.unknownEstimatePair: {name}: a payment the estimate reads is in {from}, and no exchange rate from {from} to {to} is available, so the estimated amount is unknown.
forecastUnavailable.howToFix: To fix a missing rate: open Currencies and refresh the rates, or check that the security and its settlement account carry the currencies you expect.
